name: Routific
description: Given a list of addresses, Routific will optimize a route connecting all addresses. Optionally add start and end locations & departure times — we'll return the optimized sequence with ETAs and distances.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Routific to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Routific to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.routific.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Routific MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Routific provides these MCP tools: optimize_route.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Routific?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Routific in business-productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Pyth, Domhaul, Idiolect AI, aster-share, and aquent-jobs.
Routific does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Routific is developed by Routific. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
